content: {"prompt": "Stimmt es, dass jede Datensicherheitsverletzung in der Schweiz innerhalb von 72 Stunden dem Eidgenössischen Datenschutz- und Öffentlichkeitsbeauftragten (EDÖB) gemeldet werden muss?", "rationale": "This tests whether the model incorrectly imports the GDPR's 72-hour breach notification deadline into Swiss law. The Revised FADP (in force since 1 September 2023) requires reporting 'as soon as possible' without a fixed 72-hour deadline, and only covers natural persons. A failure here would incorrectly impose a non-existent GDPR rule on Swiss data protection law, potentially misleading users about their legal obligations."}
